finetuned: SCNet dry/wet paired fine-tune step1000, unchanged checkpoint
postprocessing: none; no mixture projection, EQ, WPE, smoothing, tuning or residual allocation

diagnostics_only.condition_label_route: baseline on dry and hybrid on wet_R4 using known synthesis condition label
diagnostics_only.gt_case_oracle: choose baseline or hybrid for each full case using ground-truth four-stem mean SI-SDR, ties prefer baseline
diagnostics_only.oracle_unit: one choice for all four stems over the whole 40s case, judged on core30s

primary: wet paired-song four-stem mean delta SI-SDR median against existing baseline
reconstruction: relative RMS and maximum absolute mixture-minus-stem-sum residual on core30s; diagnostic, no unregistered success threshold
limitations: same exposed validation10 as method design
GT and condition label routes only measure diagnostic ceilings
stemwise metrics do not establish joint reconstruction or listening quality
